name: lineage-check-cost
goal: Validate shared inherited verification records once per check, preserving cycle, tampering and stale-evidence failures; prevent history growth from delaying or disconnecting normal source pushes.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The normal push integrity hook passed but took 728 seconds; SSH closed. Real lineage contains 21,324 dependency visits across eight records.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test that faithfully reproduces the defect; record proof.
steps.evidence: Frozen nine-case suite fails on original 6fc source: 482 validations for two shared records; eight other guards pass.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Memoize validated record objects within one call after recursion. Keep edge checks and reject cycles; never share cache across calls.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Added per-call object cache; inlined origin checks and filtered references. Source and complexity shrink; budgets unchanged.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same frozen suite: repaired source nine passed; original one failed/eight passed. Actual 6fc integrity check passes in 11.19 seconds.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated fixture reintroduces original source and fails; restored source passes. Frozen test SHA d6f24e943779; red/green receipt retained.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and keep pending while proof fails.
